questions.question: Types of 'Data Conversion' in C#?
questions.explanation: C# has both implicit conversion (widening, no cast) and explicit conversion (narrowing, requires a cast).

questions.question: The subset of 'int' data type is __________
Type of Conversion in which compiler is unable to convert the data type implicitly is?
questions.explanation: 'int' is 32 bit signed integer whereas 'uint' is 32 bit unsigned integer. Range of int is larger than uint. So, the compiler cannot implicitly convert from larger data type to smaller data type.
